I am a Senior Research Fellow at the [Australian Council for Educational Research](https://acer.org/). I earned my PhD in [History and Philosophy of Science at The University of Melbourne](https://www.hpsunimelb.org/), where I was a member of the [MetaMelb research group](https://www.metamelb.org/).
